Express Union NEXT

A product concept prepared for the founder of Express Union, the Cameroonian money-transfer and microfinance network: one account reachable through an application, messaging channels, agencies and an API, backed by a double-entry ledger and PIN-gated authorisation.

Visit the site ↗How to useIn motion

01

Problem statement

Express Union built one of Cameroon’s best-known transfer networks on agencies and trust. Customers now transact increasingly by telephone and communicate through messaging applications, yet transfers between networks, merchant payments and tontine savings still often involve queues, cash and no lasting record. The founder asked for a picture of the next stage.

02

Contribution

One account is reachable through four channels: the application; an Express Union number on WhatsApp, Telegram and SMS for people who will not install an app; the agency; and an API. Customers send to Express Union, MTN or Orange numbers after the recipient’s name is confirmed, pay bills and merchants, fund the account from mobile money, pay or receive by tapping phones (NFC) and withdraw cash with a code; a merchant’s own phone can act as a Tap to Phone terminal. A personal agent prepares recurring operations and a virtual receptionist answers questions and books appointments, but no transfer executes without the customer’s PIN. Community finance covers tontines, collections, group gifts, paid groups, payment pages for creators and verified requests for help.

03

Architecture

React and TypeScript with Vite and Tailwind. The ledger runs in the browser and records every movement as balanced debit and credit entries in whole francs, never in floating point, with idempotent commands and reversals in place of deletions.

04

Method and data

Daily ceilings depend on the customer’s verification level; PINs are stored as salted hashes, and an account locks after three wrong attempts. Contactless payment relies on a 60-second authorisation armed by the PIN; reading and writing NFC tags uses Web NFC in Chrome for Android, and the rest of the exchange is simulated. Agency details are displayed only when they have been verified.

05

Verification and limitations

The MTN, Orange, WhatsApp, Telegram and SMS integrations are simulated, and the ledger is a client-side demonstration, not a production core-banking system. The guide and the book were written from the code and from public sources.
